observations: APIOP-051 (POST /api/merchant/shopify/customization) is a NEW operation, not previously mapped under the prior APIOP-039..050 range for object SDK. Numbering for this run starts at APIOP-051 per orchestrator instruction.

The operation IS present in the successful-ATC capture (store2-network-events2.json, single occurrence, fires immediately before the Shopify native POST /cart/add) and is ABSENT (zero occurrences, confirmed by exhaustive scan of all entries and all hosts) from the failed-ATC capture (store2-network-events.json). Both network capture files use a reduced schema of only {t, method, url, resourceType} -- no request headers, no response status, no request/response body were captured for ANY entry in either file, including this operation.
